chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Al-Abbas ibn Aamir, from Abu Jameela, from Zayd al-Shahham, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The wine is the starting point of every sin'.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of wine in Islamic teachings according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in al-Kafi, establishes wine as the 'head' (ra's) of all sins, a metaphorical designation in Shia jurisprudence indicating that intoxicants are the primary cause of moral and legal transgressions. This principle underscores the comprehensive nature of the prohibition, linking the physical act of drinking to the root of broader ethical decay and judicial errors.
